newsitem.title: PERU: Small quake in Peru, no damage.
newsitem.headline: Small quake in Peru, no damage.

text.p: A small earthquake struck southern Peru on Sunday but there were no reports of casualties or damage, officials said.

"At 3:43 p.m. (2043 GMT) an earthquake was registered measuring 3.4 on the Richter scale with an epicentre about 50 km (30 miles) northwest of Canete", a spokesman for Peru's Civil Defence agency said.

The town of Canete is located about 90 miles (150 km) south of the capital Lima. A quake below four on the Richter scale, which measures the magnitude of an earthquake in terms of the energy it releases, is not considered large.
"The report from around the country has been that there was no damage, nothing to report," the spokesman said.
